subject: reasoning
question: Each of P, Q, R, S, T, U and V has an exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week. P has the exam on Thursday. U has the exam on one of the days after R and on one of the days before T. V has the exam on one of the days after S but on one of the days before Q. S has the exam on one of the days after P. How many people have the exam before V?
solution:
Given: Each of P, Q, R, S, T, U and V has an exam on a different day of a week, 

Starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week.

1) P has the exam on Thursday.

2) U has the exam on one of the days after R and on one of the days before T.

3) V has the exam on one of the days after S but on one of the days before Q.

4) S has the exam on one of the days after P.

Thus, the number of the person before V is 5.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 2".**
